rule: A case is `train` when the first byte of sha256("<seed>:<case directory name>") is below 154 (about 60%), else `test`. The rule depends on the case's name alone, so adding a case never moves another.
seed_note: Drawn at random from 32 bits and redrawn (3 draws in all) until train held 4 or 5 of the 8 cases, on case counts only, before any case had been run. Every case added since is assigned by the rule, never by hand.
